Hi Alicia — thanks for the metadata and the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (solutions) and Laura (security) to get a concise integration checklist and required artifacts. Quick answers while they chime in: 

- We provide an ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) URL and Entity ID for the private control plane; ACS is a tenant-scoped HTTPS endpoint that must be reachable from your IdP over the internet (we can provide a short-lived URL for initial setup if your egress is restricted).
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 with group push; typical attributes we map: userName (email), givenName, familyName, active, groups. We also accept custom claims for role mapping.
- IAM/service accounts: Redwood will accept customer-provided IAM role ARNs for agent/service access. We recommend a cross-account role with a restricted assume-role policy and an external ID.

Hi Alicia — attached is our implementation guide for private control plane identity integration (redwood-id-implementation-guide.pdf) and a simple VPC network diagram (vpc-network-diagram.png). Summary of the checklist below — I kept it action-oriented so your ops team can tick boxes: 

1) SAML/SSO (Okta)
   - Collect: IdP metadata XML (you already sent), primary SP-initiated ACS URL (we will provide), and a public cert (if Okta requires).
   - Required assertion attributes: email (userName), givenName, familyName. Optional: department and title.
   - NameID format: emailAddress.
   - Attribute mapping: we will map Okta groups to Redwood roles using a simple prefix (e.g., RWD_admins -> admin).

2) SCIM provisioning
   - SCIM endpoint: tenant-scoped HTTPS endpoint with mutual TLS or token-based auth (token preferred for private setups).
   - Allowed operations: Users: create/update/deactivate, Groups: add/remove members.
   - Required SCIM attributes: userName, id, emails[type=work], displayName, active, groups[].

3) IAM/service accounts and role mapping
   - Pattern: arn:aws:iam::<acct-id>:role/Redwood-Private-Connector-<tenant>
   - Trust policy: allow sts:AssumeRole from our service principal and include an externalId for your tenant.
   - Keys: we prefer short-lived credentials exchanged via STS; long-lived keys discouraged.

4) Network & egress
   - Outbound: control plane needs to receive SAML requests and SCIM calls from your IdP; for initial setup allow outbound HTTPS to the provided ACS and SCIM endpoints.
   - If your VPC blocks internet egress, we can do a temporary tunnel or provide a static egress IP range on request (requires enterprise plan).

5) Security/compliance notes
   - We log SAML assertion validation events and retain audit trails per your retention policy (configurable).
   - SCIM user sync has a dry-run mode to validate mappings before mass provisioning.

Next steps I suggest:
- Your team to confirm whether token-based SCIM auth is acceptable or mutual TLS is required.
- Send a draft IAM role ARN and preferred role naming convention.
- Do you want us to generate SP metadata and a test ACS endpoint for initial exchange?

I'll attach the guide and diagram. Happy to run a 30-min technical onboarding call with your IdP admin.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Adding a few operational constraints from the infra side so Acme can prep: 

- IAM role negotiation: recommend Acme create a cross-account role with a narrow assume-role policy allowing only the Redwood connector principal. Include externalId and limit session duration to 1 hour. Example ARN pattern in Marissa's doc is correct.
- KMS & secrets: if you plan to use KMS-wrapped secrets for any service account, let us know the CMK ARN and key policy; we need decrypt permissions.
- SCIM endpoint: if you're going to host SCIM behind private networking, we support a token-exchange proxy that polls from our control plane into a customer-managed endpoint (pull model) — this avoids opening inbound rules. If you prefer push, we will expect your SCIM endpoint to accept our HTTPS calls from a fixed IP range.
- Logging/audit: we'll expose CloudWatch-compatible logs via a cross-account delivery role if you prefer to ingest them; otherwise we store logs in our control plane with export options.

Operational ask list for Acme (if possible before the call):
- IdP metadata (done)
- Sample IAM role ARN + external ID to test assume-role flow
- Preferred SCIM auth mode (token or mTLS)
- Any IP allowlist constraints for outbound HTTPS

I'll be on the technical onboarding call for the trust-policy walkthrough.

— Hiro
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
